proposed_comments.title: Group shortcut collection tab navigation
proposed_comments.body:
### Group the shortcut collection's Tab navigation

**Severity:** `medium`

This change makes the surrounding `ScrollViewer` non-tab-stop, but `MainItemsRepeater` still has no `TabFocusNavigation` grouping while each shortcut item remains individually tab-stop. The collection can therefore still become a long sequence of Tab stops.

Set `TabFocusNavigation="Once"` on `MainItemsRepeater`, while preserving the item focus behavior and arrow-key navigation. Verify that Tab enters and exits the collection as one group and that Up/Down still move between shortcut cards.

confidence.rationale: The live diff makes the surrounding ScrollViewer non-tab-stop, while MainItemsRepeater has no grouping navigation property and the shortcut items remain individually tab-stop.
